product_title: Flowbee Hair Cutter
review_headline: Glad I got my Flowbee you should get one too
review_body:
I love the Flowbee, I am on my second one. I got my first one in July of 1996. I was originally letting my hair grow longer, It had reached my shoulders. I am a guy, and when my hair started to flip up at the ends like Marlo Thomas on the show \\"That Girl\\" had. I decided I needed to get my hair cut, I didn't have the money or physical ability to sit in the hair stylist's chair for hours on end until I decided I liked the length so off to the \\"As Seen on TV\\" store at the Mall of America I went and got my first Flowbee.

I have VERY thick hair. So in the summer of 1999, I was using my first Flowbee and my hair killed the motor.

Well because of how happy I was with my first Flowbee, I wanted to get a second.

I am still using my second Flowbee, it has lasted me this long now 14 years (as of July 2013).

I have not had any problems with my second Flowbee, I did however purchase more oil and spacers from the Flowbee website, as some of the protection guides had broken off the spacers.

I don't know what type of oil it is but since so little is used it lasts a long time.

Since I've owned the Flowbee (July 1996) I've gone to a hair stylist 6 times. It has saved me a lot of money and it takes 15 minutes or less to cut my hair, I can cut it at 12pm or 3am doesn't matter it's always ready.

Now Flowbee does make a new mini-vac, I don't know how good that is. I use a small shop vac and that works great.

It doesn't matter your gender or age the Flowbee works.

Does it work for all types of hair. The answer is, \\"NO\\". If you have close nap hair that does not flow freely the Flowbee WILL NOT WORK for you. If your hair is fairly free flowing you can use the Flowbee.

review_headline: The Best Aftershave I Have Ever Had
review_body:
I discovered Ogallala products while doing research and decided to try a couple. I like Bay Rum so I ordered a bottle of Ogallala’s Bay Rum, Sage and Cedar. I liked it so much that I gave it 5 stars. However, since I received this Bay Rum and Sandalwood, I feel like I want to give the other one 4.75 stars. (As if that is possible) Although they both are exceptionally great products, I think this Bay Rum and Sandalwood is THE perfect scent for me. Someone else said they wished they could bathe in it and although I wouldn’t go that far, I can’t imagine any other product unseating this as my all-time favorite after shave. This is probably the best after shave I have ever had.

When used properly (shaken, of course) this goes on with an extremely nice bay and sandalwood scent with a hint of vanilla. After a little while, when it settles down a bit, I honestly don’t think it changes much. Perhaps the vanilla becomes a bit more pronounced and the bay backs off a bit while the sandalwood remains consistent but it is still, to my nose, a very pleasing scent that lasts for a couple of hours and then I’ll catch little whiffs of the scent until late in the day. I notice a slight prickling sensation when first applying but I will stop short of calling it a sting. This sensation lasts for only a minute or two before fading away, and I think this happens only on certain razor burn areas after I shave.

Some of the words that spring to mind when describing this product are wow, sensational, amazing, pleasurable, Nirvana, great, good, better, and Holy _____ (insert your word here).

Oh, and for this Bay Rum formulation, I sense absolutely no cloves or cinnamon at all for those that are worried about these usually overwhelming scents.

I would seriously recommend this product to everyone and to avoid bad reviews, please shake it well. If you are too put out or too lazy to shake the bottle a bit, then maybe you don’t deserve the pleasure of this product. Either that or maybe it’s time to start doing some push-ups or something.

All of Ogallala’s products have been great so far and I am now a regular customer for life.

product_title: Body Back Company’s Body Back Buddy Trigger Point Therapy Self Massage Tool - PARENT
review_headline: This will actually improve your life
review_body:
I never bother writing reviews, even for products which I love, but this will actually make your day to day life more comfortable. My neck and upper back (around the shoulder blades) have been chronically stiff/sore/etc for probably 6-7 years now (i'm only 30), and its a rare day when i'm feeling 100% comfortable and limber. Usually there is always a small tweak somewhere in my upper neck/back area. Just to clarify, i'm not in chronic pain or anything like that, just a nagging stiffness that rarely goes away, sometimes caused by infrequent exercise, stress, sitting at a desk all day, or just a bad pillow.

Now, the product - I got it 3 days ago. The first night, I used it for probably a solid 30-40 mins, the next night, another 15 minutes. Today, my neck is more limber and flexible than it has been in several months at least. If I can feel this way just by using this thing for 10-15 mins every day while I sit on the couch, that will be nothing short of miraculous. Yea, the first couple days you'll feel some soreness in the muscle (not to be confused with stiffness), but that's to be expected when you're really digging into your shoulder blade or neck.

A massage takes longer and will probably cost $60+. Yes, a massage is more luxurious and \\"relaxing\\", but honestly, this tool is better at getting those knots out, because you can find the EXACT spot and really dig into it hard until it loosens up. Its hard to explain the exact spot to a masseuse in the same way...

Finally, it doesn't take much strength at all to exert a LOT of pressure right where you need it. I'm 5'9\\", 160lbs, so i'm fit, but not a huge guy, and i barely need to apply any force to get some serious spot pressure.

BOTTOM LINE: if you're someone who has frequent neck/back stiffness, YOU NEED THIS!!!

product_title: Hndlebars Moustache Wax 1 Oz Tin
review_body:
Ok - forget about the heat of your thigh - or a hairdryer. Get serious! Get yourself some tongs and melt it over your stove burner. And I mean melt it completely - until there's nothing but liquid in the tin. This will give you plenty of time to apply it before it starts to cool. I do only the ends of my mustache, so I put it on with my fingers. If you do that, you'll need a paper towel to wipe it off your fingertips once it hardens. There's not really any other good way to get it off.

Speaking of that - the way to get it off is to get in a really hot shower and work it until it goes away. You can wash your face, as you normally would, without losing the wax.

I use it every few days - and in between times, if it needs help, I use a little Clubman right over the top of it. No worries!

So now that the heat issue is cleared up - here are the good points:

1) It holds very well
2) It doesn't dissolve if you get it wet or sweaty
3) Pleasant faint citrus smell (at least that's how it smells to me)
4) Lasts for days if you don't intentionally try to remove it
5) Doesn't flake

Drawbacks:

1) More time/difficulty to apply than something soft like Clubman.

The first time I tried this I thought it was a nightmare - but 3 days later when it was still in place and still holding - I was a convert. Give it a try.

product_title: iWALK 2.0 Hands Free Crutch
review_headline: These guys should get the Nobel Prize for Walking Aid Design
review_body: What's that? There is no Nobel Prize for Walking Aid Design?? Well, there needs to be one now, and the guys who designed the iWalk need to get the first one. I'm going on faith that we'll all be invited to the award show after-party.    I'm one of those people who says \\"I don't write many reviews on Amazon,\\" and indeed in 15 years I've written only a handful. But I find this product so great that I must do so, right now, at 2:18am.    The product has its drawbacks, mostly in its learning curve, and I would have given it four stars as a result. But I gave it a fifth star for the profound glee that I have each time I use it and realize how much more time, hassle and pain I would've had if I were using my cam boot and crutches instead. Mind you, it doesn't replace the boot, but it cuts way back on the need to use it.    There I was, a 46 year-old guy a few days from bunion surgery - the uglier kind with screws and the works, so I was going to need extra recovery time. My wife was pushing for one of those knee-scooters about which I thought: \\"smart, practical, but ridiculous.\\"    So I find myself reading the iWalk reviews and getting intrigued. Given its reasonable price and Prime shipping, I decided to veto my wife's scooter reco -- a bold decision since she's usually right about these things. But with so many knee scooters also on Prime I knew I could save myself if needed.    Happily I have not had to be saved. The rundown:     - Be sure to order, assemble and get used to using this thing before you need it. If you aren't good with furniture from Ikea and other great mysteries of the universe, then you should get help because you may have a hell of a time assembling this on your own. I love mechanical stuff and found myself fascinated as I was putting together the iWalk, but I kept thinking about the many smart people who would be cursing throughout the process. The directions are not 100% consistent in how they refer to certain parts, in a way that's subtle but bound to frustrate many people.     - As for actual use, there are nuances to learn in how you strap this on, take it off and walk with it. Had I left this learning to post-op, when I'm in pain and a slip would be very ugly, the iWalk would probably still sit untouched.    That's it for the cons. Pros:     - Despite its slight complexity and mostly-plastic construction, this thing is well-designed and built like a tank.     - Once  you get the hang of the straps, you'll be in, up on and out of the iWalk faster than crutches and a boot. But it doesn't replace those, at least for me. If you're woozy on painkillers or at risk of getting your toes knocked around, you probably want the extra armor. For those reasons, I didn't try to use the iWalk for real until 1.5-2 days or so after my operation and I will sometimes use a crutch with the iWalk for extra security.     - For routine tasks like quick bathroom breaks, brushing teeth, washing up (not showering), and hopping to the kitchen for a drink or a snack, you can't beat it.    I could go on, but it's now after 3am and the painkillers are kicking in, so off I go. If the caveats about assembly and usage don't scare you, then grab one of these.    See you at the celebration in Oslo!

product_title: Zephyr HxM BT Wireless Heart Rate Sensor, Black
review_headline: An innovative HRM package delivered with a cheapo uncomfortable strap
review_body:
I bought the Zephyr Bluetooth heart rate monitor(not the one with the new low power 4.0 Bluetooth, just the normal BT).

Previously I had a Polar HRM watch, with a Polar strap.

The Polar watch was a rock solid product, but it was kinda Spartan: it lacked training analisys functions.
Watches containing those functions do cost a fortune, so I decided to move the smartphone (Samsung Galaxy Mini2, Android 2.3) way (for the cycling I do it is more practical than it would be for running)

I have read lots of bad reviews about the Polar Bluetooth sensor.
Promised battery capacity seems to be a simple marketing lie for Polar: one customer, who claims to be an engineer developing Bluetooth technology even measured the current draw of the device, and presented a simple math: the power consumption is just too much to achieve (even the half of) the promised battery life .

So I checked out the Zephyr product line. With its free-to use software development kit and cutting (?bleeding?) edge Bluetooth Smart (Bluetooth 4, next generation, low power) product this company seems to be well-positioned and really innovative.
The normal BT sensor is promised to run 26 hours on a full charge. And this (unlike the Polar) has generally positive feedback. It only takes a slightly bigger battery, so simple it is.

Ordering and delivery was quick, it arrived within a week (!from the US to Hungary!, thanks to DHL)

After trying Endomondo (monthly \\"premium\\" subscription is a theft) and Sports Track Live, I settled with Runtastic Pro as tracking/HRM/cardio training software.

I find both the sensor and the software very good and together they're way more informative (especially in the training analisys) than my previous watch was.

However with the chest strap I'm not satisfied. The Polar one I had before had a better design. This tends to loose its shape and behaves more like a string than a strap. Not very comfortable for a fatty like me :) It may better suit some skin-and-bones people, I don't know.

You can see that they have been trying to cut down production costs on the strap, which is a shame.
This could have been a flawless package, if only the strap would be a little bit better designed/better fabric (?maybe a bit wider?).

I don't think it is wise for an innovative and upcoming company to ruin its (positive) reputation on small details like this. Not in strong competition.
And not with a relatively expensive product.
I don't belive the package would cost significantly more if it had a better quality strap.

I strongly recommend the Zephyr Bluetooth heart rate monitor as a package, but I will surely check to see if there's an alternative for the chest strap itself.

product_title: Conair 207P Infinity Tourmaline Ceramic Hair Dryer
review_body:
I bought this recently to replace a Remington hair dryer, which I've had for at least 5+ years. The Remington is still working, but it's slowly declining in power, so I wanted to have a backup. On a side note, I have near shoulder length thin, fine, straight hair.

After reading endless reviews on hair dryers, I selected this one & am happy with my choice thus far. The wattage of this hair dryer quickly dries my hair - I use the High speed setting & the Medium heat setting.

Additionally, I found that both of these same settings work well when I am styling my hair with a round brush. There were a few other hair dryers that I was considering; however, several people mentioned that the unit blew the hair around too violently to be able to style with a round brush, so I figured that this unit, having 3 speed settings, should be a good fix for that problem. But even on the High speed setting, I find that it is still perfectly manageable to use with my round brush. Further, some reviews stated that this unit does not get hot enough, even on the High heat setting. But for my hair, the Medium heat setting is plenty hot.

Regarding the unit's weight, it is about the same weight as my Remington. After inspecting some in the stores, this unit is definitely heavier than other hair dryers of similar wattage; however, I think that weight also relates to quality. A heavier, sturdier hair dryer is likely of higher quality than a really light one, & may last longer (just my opinion). And, since it's about the same weight as my Remington, it is fine for me; I'm accustomed to heavier hair dryers.

The reason I gave this unit 4 stars instead of 3, however, is because of the button slides on the unit. To adjust the heat/speed settings, you have to slide the buttons up or down, & that is quite difficult. On the button slides, there's little bumps to provide a bit of grip on them, but they don't really help. Every time I turn this unit on/off it is a struggle.a struggle.

product_title: Fitbit Flex Wireless Activity and Sleep Wristband
review_headline: You can do it... this band will tell you get off your arse!
review_body:
This band is amazing, but I don't expect it to last forever. If it breaks and it's not soon like some of the other reviewers claimed I will definitely replace it.

Unlike it's competitors the fitbit band doesn't inaccurately count moving your arm as a step - yay for accuracy.

Also, if you pair this device with the fitbit app you are on your way to serious weight loss without medication, or starvation. You can set your step goals to help you burn more fat and calories to create the kind of discpline you need to maintain or create a healthy life.

I went from being sedentary to walking 15,000 - 18,000 steps a day and I immediately started losing weight.

So, it works like this you have to burn 3,000 calories to lose ONE pound! The website will tell you how many calories you need to burn and eat in order to have a deficit each week that would amount to you losing 1/2, 1, or 2 lbs a week. So you log your food and activities and it tracks your steps and the next thing you know you are searching through your closet only 3 weeks in you've lost a pants size. Go you!

So, here's my advice...

Don't buy it if you aren't going to use it! The battery indicator on the app tells you when it needs to be recharged and it charges very quickly, so you have no reason to be without it for extensive periods of time. If you over eat don't be hard on yourself just get up and walk it off. Whatever you do keep in mind that the weight loss industry is a multi-billion dollar business and it's mostly made up of books. No one ever lost weight by reading a book, get up and move around! Use this band to encourage that movement. :)

Don't set the silent alarms they make the battery die faster!

review_headline: Fast, but takes a little practice.
review_body: I have owned this product for about three weeks.  Coming from a Braun 8000 series foil shaver, it has taken about a week for my skin to acclimate to the different shave.  Compared to the Braun, this shaver is noticably smoother as it glides across my face, and doesn't vibrate quite as aggressively, which is a pleasant change.  Very easy to clean, charges fully in 65 minutes and in three weeks I have not charged it but once.  I have also learned that contrary to the foil shaver which yielded best results when used in an up-the-grain, stroking motion, this shaver seems to work fastest when moved in a circular, swirling motion.  I consider my beard to be medium-coarse, and with a little practice, I've been able to get a satisfactory once-a-day shave in about one minute, neck and all.  Do be careful though; (this is where it looses one star) although the heads conform to your face reasonably well, when working under and towards the jawline, the edges of the heads can dig in and bite you if you go upwards too hard and don't assist the leading edge up and over your jawline.

review_body: This is the worst scale I have ever purchased.  I purchased it because of the large numbers.  The scale never corrected its weight once you got on it no matter how many times I tried to get an improved reading.  I would have to wait until the next day to get a new reading.  The scale was also very loose - in other words, when I lifted it up or down, the scale would wiggle a lot and become noisy when I put it down.  I thought it was broken but couldn't find anything wrong with it.  I was greatly disappointed in it.  The next scale I purchase will have to be a mechanical one where I can see the weight dial move back and forth.  I am a small person who weighs no more than 103 pounds and this scale would always say 190.60 pounds or 153.40 pounds or 180.90 pounds.  I knew the scale was off immediately; I purchased new batteries several times thinking this was the problem but it wasn't.  I threw it out with the trash as I feel that this scale was very defective and I won't buy another one of this sort.  I am going back to the old fashion ones where I can see the scale dial actually move in front of me; thereby, giving me a more accurate weight.  It's too bad I wasted my money on this scale because it had an attractive look to it.

product_title: Bravo-fit Boot Stretcher Ladies' 5-8
review_body:
These were clearly not field tested. The bar is too long to fit into a woman's size 8 shoe by at least 2\\" therefore, no one will be able to put it into any boot that does not have a zipper or is very short from heel to boot top (ankle hight).

So much for the fancy joint, which is pointless without the 180 degree bend being possible. The bar will be far too long for sizes smaller than my size 8, no way these will fit into 5's. They seem to be just men's sized tools with smaller front on it.

The wooden, front adjustable part, is too small for a size 8 woman's foot, more suited to tiny, pointy-toed, high-heeled stilettos than to a pair of walking boots. The width is not adjustable enough to stretch the shoes, the point of the tool.

Maybe, these are the right sized forms for a women's size 5, in that case they need to make more gradations of these parts. They will still, however, need to put all forms for smaller feet on different tool bars.

Summary. Main bar too long. Wooden forms too small and width too narrow. Epic Fail. I wish I could give zero stars.

Buy it if you have a rubber mallet, ankle length/side zip boots, AND lots of time time re-engineer.

product_title: HoMedics Facial System with Pore Cleanser
review_body: This was a gift for Christmas last year.  In an entire year I can say that I actually got it to work maybe 7 times.  The brush is a little hard for the delicate skin on your face.  The exfoliating stuff smells really bad.  One day after making sure it was charged I went to use it and it didn't work.  I thougth maybe I just didn't charge it right.  Well, it has since not worked.  This was the biggest waste of $40 I have seen. I wish I could return this poor product.

product_title: Reflex Roller Deluxe Kneading Massager
review_body: Overall a great product.  The rollers feel great on your feet and provides a very relaxing massage experience.  Although still doesn't beat an actual foot massage from a CMT, its the next best thing and costs a heck of alot less too.

product_title: EAR WAX REMOVAL SYRINGE
review_body: I have had major ear wax build-up for years.  When I tried this product alone, it got a little wax out, but not very much compared to how much was left in my ear.  When I used it after putting Similasan Ear Wax Relief drops in my ears for three days, then everything came out.  This syringe is good for minor ear wax build-up problems used by itself; for serious ear wax build-up, use it in conjunction with the Similasan Ear Wax Relief drops, and you'll be all set.  The three-fold spray helps the water get behind the wax and pushes it out.  You can force the water out as hard or as gently as you want, depending on how sore your ear is and how blocked up it is.  It's awkward to use by yourself, but it can be done; however, I would recommend having someone else do it for you if possible.

product_title: Slip-X Deluxe Square Shower Mat
review_body: Nice product; however, always nice to know the actual size before purchasing the item.  This is pretty small for my shower.

product_title: [Itm] Medium Textured Alcohol Prep Pad, 1 1/4" x 2 1/2" [Acsry To]: Alcohol Prep ... see description
review_headline: Like what you find in the hospital
review_body: I came home from the hospital and needed more alcohol preps, and this was exactly what they had in the hospital.

product_title: T.E.D. Knee Length Closed Toe 3 Pair, Extra Large Long
review_body: Overall, I was initially satisfied. One of the 3 pairs tore after only two uses. While the other two pair are still in use, a 66% is a failing score in any classroom!

product_title: Samsung A460 USB Data Cable No Charging
review_body: Odered the cable and it appeared within a couple of days.  Extremely quick response!

product_title: Powermatic 2 Electric Cigarette Injector Machine
review_body: Recieved this product quickly, that's the only good thing about it. The thing is so tiny and makes the crappiest cigarettes. I bought this with the hopes of being a quicker, easier alternative to the manual rolling machines, but after each cigarette is rolled you have to pack them vigorously because it doesn't eject enough tobacco into the tubes. I have played with the amount of tobacco put in the hopper, reguardless it still doesn't pack the tobacco all the way down to the filter. And the seller will not except it for return after any use, don't waste your money on this, or you will be stuck with a $100 paperweight!

product_title: Panasonic ES8003W Men's Wet/Dry Rechargeable Linear Shaver
review_body:
Compared with Norelco's, the Panasonic shaver was disappointing:
1. The shaves are not as close on men with medium beards
2. As a stiff foil shaver, it does not contour around bony areas, such as the chin, as well as the floating, rotating heads on the Norelco.
3. The shaver leaves the stubbles of your beard in your sink, making for a messy daily clean-up.
I had high expectations with Panasonic's claim of such high RPM's of blade movement. Unfortunately, the quality of the shave is limited by the foil design. Even higher RPM's would not fix its weaknesses.

product_title: COMMODE, EXTRA WIDE, 24IN WIDE, 650 LB CAP
review_body: Ordered this product from Amazon when a regular size commode was uncomfortable.  This is a quality product and was half the price of medical supply places.

product_title: ID Glide Water Based Personal Lube Lubricant 9.7 oz. Pump
review_body: The lube itself is decent- water based, rinses off easily, doesn't make too much of a mess of leave things sticky as long as your wash things off with water. The pump works great, but the problem is once you open it, when you try to put the cap back on, it pushes the pump half way down which squirts lube everywhere and makes a huge mess.. really idiotic design, someone clearly wasn't thinking.. Overall, decent lube but definitely overpriced for 9.7 ounces (I paid $25).

product_title: Color Indo Board Pro - Sunburst
review_headline: Once you've mastered the Original Indo, step up to the big board
review_body:
As is suggested by the manufacturer, I started with the Original Indo Board and would suggest this route to others. The Original is more manageable, and I still use it even though I have the Pro now. The variety adds additional interest to my workout.

Once you have mastered the Original, I highly recomend this board for additional challenge (smaller riders may want to check out the Pro Mini). With the bigger board and roller, range of motion is dramatically increased. I use my Indo Boards nearly every day, and I previously had never been able to consistently work out.

BY FAR THE MOST FUN AND ADDICTIVE EXERCISE EQUIPMENT I HAVE EVER USED.

product_title: CHI Nano Dual Air Flow Ceramic Hair Dryer
review_headline: Don't waste your $$$$$- Find any other hair dryer!
review_body: I would have returned this right after I used it for the first time, however there is NO return with this company where it was purchased from.  This is the worst hair dryer I have ever had.  After using it, my  hair was frizzy, out of control, and  looks like I had been at the beach all day. I am very proficient at styling my hair, but this is by far the worst hair dryer I have ever used. A complete waste of money.

product_title: Inner Tube 3 Biofeedback Game for the Wild Divine
review_body: This is a software programme to be used with the wild divine light stone. You will travel through a tunnel in some sort of spaceship - different styles of vehicles and tunnels are available. When you are relaxed - this will appear from your heart rate and the sweat production of your skin - the spaceship moves smoothly. When you are not, it falters, and may even turn back. At the end of the tunnel your space ship will shoot into the clear blue sky.    Very entertaining and it will increase your awareness of stress and tension, and how to be more in control of your emotional state. After a few sessions I was able to influence the movement of the spaceship for short periods of time, and with more practice I got better and better at it. The effects lasted for a while after I finished the game.    So it really taught me something about myself. Useful and fun. I let some friends try it too and they all liked it and were impressed with the results. Men and women alike.

product_title: Graco NasalClear Aspirator
review_body: I got this product because my daughter's nasal passages are smaller than the average infant.  She is constantly congested and it makes it hard for her to sleep or eat.  It was easy to use and perfect for a smaller nose.  I talked about it in a therapy group for children with Down Syndrome.  No we are all getting or have one.

product_title: Certified Classic XL Analog Scale
review_body: I bought one of these travesties, and when I arrived home and opened the box, I found the dial registering 100 pounds with nothing on the scale. The box is slathered with claims of \\"German Accuracy\\" and other such marketing nonsense, but the Chinese assemblers and QC department was evidently fast asleep when they inspected and shipped it.

product_title: LG-7000 Premium TENS Unit with 5 Treatment Modes 2nd Edition
review_body: Great product..I have found it very helpful to control chronic back pain to avoid taking prescription pain meds and therefore allowing me to continue working as a nurse.  The stimulator was as advertised and has several modes to choose. A good price and good quality product.I love that it  is small and can clip on to your clothing so you can wear it around the house while it's blocking your discomfort.And a plus is that it did not require a prescription which generally would make the price prohibitive. A good value and delivered quickly!!!

product_title: Hj-113 Pocket Pedometer
review_body: After reading several other reviews I chose the Hj-113 Pocket Pedometer.  It is my first pedometer, but I am trying to get healthier, and wanted to be aware of the number of steps I take in my normal routine.  I found this pedometer to be easy to use and I like that it resets itself every night at midnight. I also like that I can set it for the length of MY steps, so that I know it is accurate.  It has fallen out of the case it sits in a few times, but I didn't lose it because it was also attached with the cord, a nice feature to ensure you don't lose it.  I give it 5 stars because I haven't found anything I didn't like about it.

product_title: Finally Free F-140 Ultra-Permanent Hair Removal System
review_headline: Finally Free Hair Removal Worked For Me!
review_body: I was sceptical at first when i ordered this product.  But when i tried it, it actually worked. I was extremely suprised.  It takes a few treatments, but each person is different in how long it takes to actually see results.  After 3 treatments i no longer have any hair on my stomach, upper lip, breasts and even under my arms.  Thanks to Finally Free Hair Removal, i no longer have to shave.  Try it, it really works.

product_title: ForPro Cotton Gloves 12-pr.
review_headline: A basic product doing its job
review_body: These gloves arrived promptly and in good condition.  Although they come in pairs, there is really no right or left hand, which for me is good since I only use them on one hand.  These beat out cotton gloves I had bought from another company because one, they were less expensive and two, they were bigger.  The other company's gloves split at the seam in many cases, I think because they were smaller and harder to fit over my hand (especially after a washing).  If you have small hands, you might find these gloves too loose, otherwise, they are hard to beat.

product_title: Powermatic 2 Electric Cigarette Injector Machine
review_body: This machine is much faster and alot easier than the hand crank machine I had (which was wearing out). I can make a pack in about 10 minutes. Works best with drier tobacco and you have to make sure you pack it tight on the filter end or it doesn't fill the tube tight.

product_title: Philips Sonicare Brush Heads
review_headline: Superior to the old style brush heads, and Cheaper Too!
review_body:
These new heads, which fit ONLY the new Flexcare and ProResults models of brushes, are superior to the old Elite style brush heads in several ways. The standard head remains the same size and shape as the old heads, but adds the following:

1. No more old toothpaste/mildew/mold/germs collecting in the base of the brush head! By far the most unpleasant aspect of the old Sonicare brushes, this problem is gone with the smaller, simple to rinse off ProResults heads.

2. New \\"indicator\\" bristles let you know when it's time to change. A common feature in manual brushes, it's nice to see this on a Sonicare brush head.

3. Less waste - there is less bulk to the new ProResults heads, meaning much less waste and more environmental benefit. The metal content has been reduced as well, making these heads about even or even better than regular manual brushes in environmental impact.

4. Best of all, the new models are actually CHEAPER than the old models. You get a 3 pack of brush heads for what 2 of the old brush heads costs. They're still more expensive than manual brushes, but its worth the price for the superior brushing experience.

Overall the new brush head system is great - just make sure it fits your handle. You need a Flexcare or ProResults Sonicare handle to use these brush heads (sorry elite and essence users!).

product_title: Scojo Popeyes Glitz
review_body: I have owned this brand before and have loved them. The only  problem is that already one of the crystals have come out.  The ones I had before the crystals stayed in so much better.  Would I get again? Maybe, but I hope that you can mention it  to the company, so I can purchase again. Thanks for listening.

product_title: LeClaire & Bayot Striped Medium Natural Bristle Toothbrush
review_body: Excellent Toothbrush. Made perfect for cleaning your teeth. No harsh plastic brushes to slide over your teeth without cleaning it. This is the only way to ever brush your teeth. Use the one and only method for brushing, natural bristles toothbrushes.

product_title: Luna Sport Moons
review_headline: A must have for those of us who can't stomach Gels!
review_body: I am a marathon runner who absolutely cannot stomach running gels.  The consistency, texture...BLAH!!  I've tried the Jelly Belly sport beans, but they are a bit to grainy and make my mouth dry.  I've also used the shot bloks by Clif, and those are decent, but are still a bit hard to get down in the middle of a marathon when your mouth is dry.    I tried the Luna Moons at the Nike Womens Marathon in San Francisco this past October, and I LOVED THEM!! They had samples out at the expo, and then had them on the course.  The taste and texture were both wonderful!  Plus I like that they are organic, and are specifically made for female athletes.     I found that they were much easier to chew than the shot bloks, and I didn't need water to get them down, as with the jelly belly sport beans.     I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: Fun Factory Smartballs
review_body: It's a great feeling having the Smart Balls inside... with every step you can feel them moving inside, gently stimulating and exciting you. The fact that no one will know they're there (unless you decide to share) only adds to the excitement.

product_title: OptiSIGHT Magnifier Visor
review_headline: So good that I'm buying a second one!
review_body:
I bought my Optisight magnifying visor about 4 years ago from a woodcarving shop and paid two dollars more! I paint and carve wood. Today I'm buying one as a birthday present for my grown daughter who strings beads and works with polymer clay.

When I first bought my Optisight visor I thought it looked cheap and just might be one of those things you regret buying. Boy, was I wrong to doubt the usefulness of this clever little visor! I use it several times a week and often keep it on for three to four hours. It is surprisingly comfortable to wear and, other then a few paint smears, it is still in mint condition.

One big advantage this visor has over other magnifiers is that you can swing the lens frame up over your forehead when you need to quickly go back to normal vision. Sometimes I sit in a chair and carve or sew while watching TV and I've learned that I can just look up over the magnifying lens and see the TV just fine!

product_title: Baseline Bubble Inclinometer
review_body: This inclinometer is excellent for doing range of motion tests of the spine and extremities. It is easy to read and dial in. The only issue I have with it is that it scratches VERY easily. This is an expensive piece of plastic so it may be a good idea to keep it in the bubble wrap that it comes in when not in use. Good buy!

product_title: CONAIR 80016 6 1/2" Professional Thinning Shears
review_body: Outstanding clippers and super speedy delivery. Had the product in my hands 4 days after ordering, and best of all, shipping was FREE. Thanks Amazon!!!

product_title: Epilady Legend Plus Hair Removal System
review_body: The epilator head unfortunately does nothing at all.  It feels like it is removing hair, but you can go over and over the same hair and it just stays there.  Luckily I bought the version which also has a shaving head, which is excellent, or I would be very disappointed.

product_title: Ez2care Deluxe Two Botton Folding Walker with 5 Inch Wheels, Anodized Silver
review_body: I need a walker for an upcoming hip replacement.  I am satisfied that this walker will work perfectly for my needs.  It is well made.

product_title: Ascensia Contour Blood Glucose Monitoring System
review_body: This is a nice easy to use glucose monitor. The test strips are expensive (even Walmart will charge you a buck a piece), but you can find them cheaper on EBAY. As for the monitor itself, go to the Bayer website, and they will send you one for free. Then they can charge you an arm and a leg for the test strips.

product_title: Slender Eyes Rectangled Shape., +2.0
review_headline: Great Glass - cool look, cool case
review_body: Hey I have had a pair for 3 years and just ordered a few for gifts.  They are good and sturdy glasses and the case is cool and easy to fit in pocket.

product_title: Just Released Omron HEM-780N3 Automatic Blood Pressure Monitor with Morning Hypertension Detection
review_headline: Excellent Quality, Accuracy, and Ease of Use
review_body: After reading two independent reviews on this Blood Pressure Cuff, both with top of the line ratings, I made the purchase and found the reviews were right on target.  This HEM-780N3 unit is very easy to use and has excellent features, such as previous BP memory readings for two different individuals.  One can carry the unit to their physician's appointment and show them the list of your previous measurements.  The cuff is easy to slip on with one hand, push the button, and your blood pressure is measured.

product_title: Swing Arm Compact Fluorescent Desk Lamp
review_body: This lamp has a solid, heavy base. Its transformer wall wart can take up more than one spot on an power strip, this is par for the course. The lamp was sagging until I remembered to attach the springs of the upper arm, which arrive unattached (it took me 10 seconds). Satisfied, recommends that item.

product_title: 6 Davinci Tools
review_body: I own many \\"toys\\" for self-massage and myofascial release. This one is my absolute favorite! So versatile, and so easy to use. I have one in my car (digging in my back/neck or hamstrings on each red light), at my computer desk and in my bed. I was so impressed with its effectiveness that I bought 13 of them and gave out as Christmas gifts to my friends and family. This is a genius in self-massage tools, and fully deserves the \\"DaVinci\\" name!

product_title: Imak Knee Strap - Each
review_body: I have for probably 10 years had some trouble with my right knee. It was twisted rather badly and I had about a six month recovery time. Still, and especially on down hills walking or jogging, I would experience pain and discomfort. I had doubts about what appeared to be a simple strap. Still, I was a bit desperate and decided to try it. I have no real idea how it works, but it does. When I fast walk down hills without the strap I have discomfort. With the strap there is a mild discomfort but certainly tolerable. I was surprised and really delighted that it works as well as it does.

product_title: LUXOR Professional Cutting Collar (Model:6019B)
review_body: This cuting cape was not how ot looked in the picture. It was allot shorter and the neck is so small it only fit arround very small necks. Also the plastic was hard.

product_title: Posture Rite Lap Desk
review_body: I use this Lap desk everyday. It is light weight and made well. I'm very satisfied with it.

product_title: Braun Oral-B D9513 Electric Toothbrush
review_body: This electric toothbrush is a great buy for the money.  I have had several models of the Braun electric toothbrush series and this one is not quite as good as the very expensive models, but a terrific buy at these prices.

product_title: Vidal Sassoon VS11353 Pronged Stick Barrette
review_body: I love using these, and have several metal ones, which tend to be too heavy and fall out. Even lighter, leather ones it seems to be difficult to guage how much hair to hold in it, and they can just slip out. This was brilliant - I bought one in Boots, on a whim - it held ANY amount of hair exactly as you put it.     Unfortunately one of the prongs broke a few months after I bought it - AND NOW I CAN'T FIND THEM ANYWHERE... please bring them back! Make them in other colours! I'd favour a brown/black one. They were great!

product_title: 2G Cool Moisture Humidifer
review_body: We had a week of -30 degree temps and the indoor humidity dropped to nothing, so I bought this model at a local Ace Hardware store that happened to be open late.  It has two settings: hi and low, they should be marked Very Loud and Extremely Loud.  We couldn't even hear the TV over the racket.  Forget about using it at night unless you live on the freeway and can sleep through anything.    After two days we took it back to the store.  It was difficult to clean, and in only two days got a musty smell that would have been a nasty thing to try to live with.   Now I'm looking for something better.  Maybe just a pot of water on the stove is the easiest and best thing.

product_title: JapanBargain Chinese Health Stress Relieve Hand Exercise Baoding Balls
review_body: I like these hollow chinese baoding balls. They are very easy to use and I like the 2 individual tones that they produce. They are perfectly in tune. As a musician-percussionist these really help me loosen up my fingers and palms. It's best to try not to clang the balls together. You want to manipulate the balls in between your 4 fingers with out dropping the balls.  I would suggest taking a lesson by watching a pro demontration on you-tube. This helped me make up my mind on which baoding balls to purchase because there are so many out there.    Good luck peace and have fun.    Vinnie, from NJ USA

product_title: Thinklabs ds32a+ Stethoscope
review_body: I also picked up my scope at a trade show (Pri-Med Boston).  That was 5 years ago and I have not been without one since. (and bought a second one because going back to a standard scope is like putting on sunglasses at night.)  I also had to send my early model in for servicing but have had good turnaround and communication with service.  I've tried other scopes at twice the price and still think that Thinklabs has better sound.  Highly recommended (with the money you save, buy a spare!)

product_title: BNRG Power Crunch Peanut Butter Fudge 12-1.4 oz Cookies
review_headline: doesn't taste like a protein bar
review_body: Among the various protein bars I've tried, Power Crunch and Oh Yeah! are the best.  For one thing, they don't taste like a protein bar, more like a regular candy bar.  Peanut Butter Fudge is my favorite flavor.  Triple Chocolate is also very good.

product_title: Oral-B S15.523.2 Pulsonic Power Toothbrush
review_body: I replaced a Philips Sonicare toothbrush with this one and in the final analysis I like this one much better.  Though I do miss the faster vibration of the Philips, my checkups at the dentist are actually better since I started using this thing.  Given this I am giving this product 5 stars instead of the 4 I might have otherwise given it.  What I don't miss about the Sonicare is the size and the inexplicable cavity (no pun intended) inside the toothbrush.  I have seen lots of complaints about the Philips that have this design.  While most people complain about battery problems from the liquid that constantly fills this compartment, my toothbush filled up with a nasty smelling liquid that made the toothbrush unusable.  This toothbrush does not suffer from this problem.  But the best thing about this toothbrush is the size!  It is so manvuerable!!  And it travels very nicely.  I  have had several large bulky toothbrushes and this one really feels like the future of electric toothbrushes.  You'll love it.

product_title: Medline Carrying Case for Freedom Ultra Light 14.5 lb Transport Wheelchair - Makes Travel Easy!
review_body: Nicely made but much larger then it needs to be for the Ultra Light Transport Wheelchair.

product_title: Body Back Company’s Body Back Buddy Trigger Point Therapy Self Massage Tool - PARENT
review_body: The Body Back Buddy was recommended for me by my physical therapist.  I live alone and am on a limited income - so I don't have a partner to help with accupressure or massage and I don't have extra money to hit the spa.  The Body Back Buddy works very well - you can get a surprisingly steady firm pressure on unreachable back pressure points with it, which helps me a lot.  I have severe fibromyalgia and osteoarthritis and this helps quite a bit.

product_title: Wall Switch Extension Handle - One package of two
review_headline: Excellent gadget for the little, independent people in your home
review_body: This extension switch is awesome for young children who can't yet reach the actual light switch....especially during middle of the night bathroom visits.  They are delighted to themselves turn on the light & you will still be fast asleep while they do it!  I bought one for the kid's bedroom & one for the kid's bathroom.  Easy to install, durable, clear so it blends in with your decor, and it wipes clean easily.  You won't be disappointed with this!!

product_title: Aura Cacia EleCTric Aromatherapy Air Freshener Refill, Relaxing Lavender - 0.47 Oz, 6 pack
review_body: I love these air fresheners. I am sensitive to chemicals ( they give me migraines) and with these I have no issues. The house smells great and they are well constructed. MY only complaint is that I wish they would last a little bit longer. They go for about 30-4 days. Also, the particular seller I got the six pack from only sent me 5. I requested the additional item, but they gave me a credit instead.  I have tried the lavender, lime, and spice scents and they are all great. The spice is the STRONGEST. Nice for the holidays but a little much for year round.

product_title: Belson Gold N Hot Jet Bonnet Dryer Attachment
review_body: I bought this (at Sally Beauty Supply) because I wanted to be able to do rollersets while I'm away at college, and so far it's doing a good job. My only problem is that the hood is just alittle small, so I have to fight alittle to fit my rollerset under it. Other than that, I would recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Conair Ceramic 2-N-1 Straightener & Curling Iron
review_body: This product was GREAT for about 6 months.  It left my hair smooth and straight (a far cry from poofy and full of friz) and the curling iron feature was excellent.  My hair looked really good.  However, it stopped heating up after about six months and I had to trash it.. quite a disappointment.

product_title: Syringe 3cc Luer Lock w/o Needle - Box of 100
review_body: Subject says it all - fast shipping - good seller..... item description said it was a syringe and by golly - it really really was a syringe - I am very glad the description matched the item I received.  Thank you very much for keeping these two things the same.

product_title: AccuMassage Self Massage Tool and Porcupine Massage Ball
review_body: This is a cleverly designed gizmo that works as advertised.  Makes you wonder why someone hadn't thought of it before.  The leverage allows you to massage & knead your own muscles as deeply as you might want, and gives easy access to back & neck muscles that are impossible to reach by yourself otherwise.

product_title: Clubman Moustache Wax, Chestnut
review_body: We had been unable to find this product anymore in our area so really happy to find a source. Delivery was within a couple of days. Great service.

product_title: Dr Scholl's ® Massaging Gel Insoles for Men
review_body: Don't know what the other reviewer is talking about. I've had a pair of these in my shoes for over a year and have never had any of the problems he's describing. They're great.

product_title: Norelco 6885XL Deluxe Quadra Action Cord/Cordless Rechargeable Men's Shaver
review_body: I just received my new Norelco last Friday and have been shaving with it only five days. The manual says it may take up to 21 days for your face to get used to it before you get the optimum shave. If it does any better shaving me than it's doing now, I may never need to shave again. Smooth! That's what I'm getting. I absolutely love this shaver. Is it worth the money? Every penny! And you can rinse out the heads with hot water. I'm very satisfied with this purchase. I also like knowing how much time is left on the charge in the batteries.

product_title: Colgate Gel-Kam, Dental Therapy Pak, Fluoride Preventive Treatment Gel, Mint Flavor, Two 3.5 tubes
review_body: Gel-KAm is the best stuff for tooth pain from hot and cold food or drinks.

product_title: Thera-Band Exercise Balls
review_headline: Thera-Band Exercise Balls are the best!

product_title: TravelRest - The Travel Pillow Reinvented for Kids & Adults
review_headline: For overnight flights, worth its weight in gold
review_body:
I fly a lot to Europe and Asia, in addition to West Coast to East Coast red-eyes. Over the years, I had tried the standard \\"horseshoe\\" neck pillows that we've all seen: I tried the inflatable ones, the ones filled with foam, the ones filled with buckwheat hulls, etc., etc. During each flight, I would fidget and fuss and try to get comfortable with the neck pillow, then eventually I give up, stuff it under my seat, and resign myself to reading instead of sleeping.

Out of desperation, I bought this product based on the incredible reviews. I was skeptical, but it was small (unlike the foam-filled neck pillows) and cost no more than a bad airport meal. So I gave it a try on a flight to India.

I was amazed. The crazy thing works! It's hard to describe how different this thing feels compared to a traditional neck pillow, but it's far more comfortable. It stays in place and seems to be a much better fit for the way your body and head want to position themselves when sleeping in an airplane seat. At last, an ergonomic airplane pillow.

In terms of price per hour of sleep, this product is a great investment. I'm glad I took a chance and bought it. I won't take another intercontinental flight without it. Kudos and thanks to the person/team that designed it.

After using this pillow for several months, I recently (a few weeks ago) bought the new microfleece cover. It puts a soft, cozy cover on the TravelRest pillow. The cover is very light weight and takes up minimal additional room. It takes a few minutes to fit it onto the pillow, but it's well worth it. It makes an already great product even cozier.

I know it sounds crazy to heap such lavish praise on a mere travel pillow, but this pillow really has made the difference between getting a few hours of sleep and no sleep at all on overnight flights. It's great.

The black tube is smooth, shiny, and not sticky...but grippy enough to stay around your neck. I imagine that when Littmann designed it they took into account that the rubber tube should grip clothing. It came with an additional set of harder earpieces that simply slide on or off. I like the earpieces that were already on the scope. I say if your really looking to save money, than try and search for a free stethoscope i.e locally, or buy a cheap one. review_body:
My doc prescribed this after my first rotator cuff surgery in Feb 2011, and it was worth every penny!

It's like an iced-water jug crossed with a little fountain. You fill the box with ice and water. A little pump in the lid circulates the cold water through a hose and into a pad (that looks like felt-covered bubble wrap) that wraps around your shoulder (or knee, etc.) and fastens with velcro straps. It will stay cold for 2-3 hours and is very comfortable.

It kept the inflammation in my shoulder to a minimum, and as inflammation can increase your pain, I slept better, which means I healed more quickly, which meant I was off the heavy painkillers sooner than expected. I even slept with this on my shoulder! It also helped during physical therapy by keeping the swelling and discomfort down throughout. Now I'm four days out of surgery on my other shoulder, and once again my trusty polar cube is helping with the inflammation and pain! If you have surgery on any joint or ligament, ask your doc to prescribe one of these. Most insurance companies will pay at least part of the cost.

And of course, always follow your surgeon's post-op care instructions, and complete your physical therapy! It doesn't matter how good your surgeon is; if you don't finish your physical therapy, you won't have the best outcome.

product_title: Reizen 4x, 50mm Golden Pendant Magnifier
review_headline: Reizen pendant magnifier - I find it useful
review_body: Who would have thought? A pendant magnifier! But already, having only worn it a few weeks, there have been a couple of times when   a)my one hand was full, holding or balancing something, and/or   b) I was in a real need to discern fine print and my readers were nowhere near, or  c) insert any one of a hundred crazy scenarios here...    and I thought, WOW, I can grab this thing from around my neck and I can SEE!! Just tonight, I was queueing up music on an old iPod in low light. The screen contrast was lousy, there were a couple of kids waiting around wanting to dance - instead of stopping everything and walking into the next room to grab a pair of readers, I just fished in my shirt, pulled up my Reizen magnifier, and I got it done.    The Reizen is bigger than any other product of its kind out there, that I could find. I don't want some postage stamp token thing, I want to be able to SEE a useful patch of real estate. It measures a full 5cm in diameter and is well constructed. The frame around the glass is strong, the glass is clear and the chain is cool. I swapped out the chain for a few different things of my own. But the beauty is, you have the option of doing that because Reizen is smart enough to make the retaining rings the chain passes thru big enough to accommodate anything you want. Well, maybe not for Flava Flav, but for me it's fine. At this point I'm using a simple black, soft craft cord. But there is something to be said for chain - when you go feeling around your neck for the thing, a nice chain makes it quicker.    Sorry, but it definitely IS HOKEY to wear a freaking MONOCLE-type thing around your neck, and I'll be the first to admit it. But when you have lived your whole life with 20-10 vision (me) you have very little tolerance for not being able to see things close up all of the sudden. (It's not sudden. I just turned 48 and my near vision started going about 10 yrs ago. But as my doctor told me, as you grow older your eye's lenses get less pliable, and the stiffer they get, the harder it is for your muscles to shape them for correct focus. Don't buy into any BS, it's normal and unavoidable for most people.) So at this point I've had it and I like the insurance of knowing that if push comes to shove, I can see fine details any time I have at least one hand free.    This thing is not a substitute for reading glasses. But when you are caught off guard in a situation where you need to be able to read small print or see in low light, it's a COOL COOL thing to realize that hanging right around your neck you have a way. The 6X magnification is powerful enough to see detail for very fine inspection. The hairs on my arm look like tiny black insulated wires, I can see miniscule dry flecks on the skin on my hand, and some very fine minutiae and 3D details on the face of my wristwatch.    I don't know if I have the cojones to be this much of a nerd in the summertime when it's shirts off, but for now, I'm loving this thing.

product_title: RediBreeze Oral Irrigator
review_headline: several years of using this product....
review_body: I have now been using a version of this product for several years now. I am addicted to the the feeling I get from clean teeth after using it. I started out with the quick-removal version, but after about a year the rubber washer that locks it in place began to get soft and it became harder to remove the unit from the sink after using. I switched to this non-removable version.     Pros and Observations:     1) no electricity.   2) nothing on the counter top, although the hose has to be wound around the faucet for storage. Or at least that is what we do.   3) temperature and pressure is very easily controlled by you.   4) the removable pic will probably never wear out, unless you smash it or crush it accidentally.   5) The hose has discolored a bit from the iron content in my water, but it is no less pliable or usable then when I first got it.     Cons:     1) you must periodically tighten down the small locking nut that holds the hose on the side of the unit. This will unscrew over time due to pivoting and maneuvering the hose. It is a simple check and you only need to keep it finger tight.   2) if you have a low faucet, this will make it lower and it extends down further then the piece you will remove. If you like to reach down under the spigot and get a hand full of water to rinse your mouth out, you may have to bend down a bit lower then normal.     I remove the whole unit from the faucet every week when I clean the bathroom and I use bathroom foam cleaner and an old tooth brush to clean it and keep it like new. I remove it using my fingers, no tools.     I like this product line so much that I have the removable version at my office and I use it in after lunch every day. I installed the permanent piece on a faucet in the bathroom and left it there. I keep the removable piece in my desk drawer.     I also have a removable version I take on travel with me when I have to go somewhere for work or pleasure. Sometimes I cannot get the piece off of the hotel faucet toinstall the water pick on, but that seldom happens. I am persistent. The wet bar long neck sinks in hotel rooms usually will accept this unit very easily. Sometimes if I know I am going to have to stay for a week or more, I will even bring a pair of pliers to remove really crusted on sink spigots. But be aware that they may be confiscated at airport security. Once they asked me about them, but they let them thru.     As far as not fitting your sink comments... The unit comes with an adapter that has at least three size threads, some are internal and some external. The only sinks that might have problems are ones with very large diameter threaded spigots. And if you are somewhat handy you can probably go to your local Lowes or Home Depot and find an adapter to make it work.     My wife and I both use this product every day.     I use it after every meal and before I go to bed. I think it is very important to do before retiring for the night.

product_title: Clic Magnetic Reader
review_headline: Durable With A Major Cool Factor...
review_body: I am incredibly tough on glasses.  I only need them to read, so I tend to put them down in places they are likely to receive damage.  The couch, a chair, or on the seat of my car, for example.  I have destroyed possibly a dozen or more glasses by sitting on them, stepping on them, or maybe even just putting them to use in strange situations.    I have already destroyed one pair of these glasses.  I took the pair to the beach.  The sand scratched the living daylights out of the lenses and ruined them.  Prior to that, though, they had survived every possible perdicament I placed them in.  They have been stepped on, sat on, dropped, thrown, and even had a door close on them.  And they survived without a blemish.    There are two factors that make these glasses quite durable.  One is the make-up of the plastic and metal that goes into them.  The other is the flexibility of the joints.  The glasses can bend every which way, so almost nothing can easily destroy them.  The lenses will scratch though, as I found out at the beach.    You can get an equivalent solution, however, for much less.  It won't be as durable, but it will be much cheaper.  You can get some basic reader glasses and put on a croakie or equivalent.  Works just as well for keeping track of your glasses without having to constantly put them down.  And the croakies you can buy to fit your head.    Still, for the flexibility, durability and design of these glasses, which has a major cool factor that people are always inquiring about, I have to give them five stars.  It would be hard to execute this better short of an adjustable head strap.  Still, the price is high.  I can buy decent reading glasses for $4 and a croakie for $1.99.  So, I could trash 5 pairs of glasses for the cost of one of these.

product_title: Exergen Temporal Artery Thermometer MODEL# TAT-2000C
review_body:
As a mom of two with a moderate medical background (I worked in a hospital as an EMT & have a biology degree focusing on anat-phys)I was looking for a reasonably accurate/ less invasive tool for taking my kids temperature after both of them got pneumonia within a week of each other.

Rectal thermometers are the best and most accurate but are the obviously the most invasive and I could see subject to trepidation for those unaccustomed to taking them. Tympanic are great look for quick reads, but subject to too much variability for reading if you don't position them correctly down the ear canal (also, positioning will change as the infant develops which is often not accounted for). Auxillary is the most accurate/ least invasive, however even then- infants may not necessarily want to cooperate and hold their arm down for the time from it takes for the thermometer to take an accurate reading... Long story short, when it was critical I had to control my kids temperatures and take them insanely often I did a lot of research and opted to try this one.

I actually ended up buying mine at Target for a bit more (because it was backordered and I needed it immediately) but wanted to give my review because I did a lot of research and found others very helpful. The thermometer basically reads temperature for the temporal artery and is extremely non-invasive requiring you to swipe the gadget from the forehead to browline while pressing a button. It beeps indicating it is taking multiple readings and then essentially averages those readings together. The beeping is quiet enough so it doesn't wake my infant and hallelujah I don't have to wake/undress my child (remember the two kids with pneumonia that I'm suffering through at the same time... that I rock forever to go to sleep) and wake him to get a temperature. It's obviously not as accurate as a rectal temp. but ideal for it's purpose. Just be aware that you have to keep the instrument flat across the dermis so it can read properly and like taking any data, the more readings the better a representation you see of whats going so, so take a few readings.

review_headline: Thumper Sport Massager, Calves and Biking
review_body: I do not write reviews.  This is my first one.  Why? Because this product did something that all the other (non percussion) massage products could not.  Some background.  I am a bicyclist by hobby - 100+ miles per week on the average at 18 - 20 mph avg speed.  For about 2 or 3 years my calves starting getting very very tight and painful. He said he never had that problem and that maybe the swimming made the knots go away.  He said that I should not have tight calves, they need to be flexible.  He suggested going to get regular massages.  Great idea, but I don't have the time with 3 young kids, nor the money to do it a lot.  I know there are new machines out there just for feet and calves, but they are limited since they do not go high enough on my calves...and I am only 5'8\\", plus they are 300 dollars or more.  I came across some productions at Brookstone...one was called a percussion massages...interesting concept.  I did some more readings on percussion massage, but no one ever mentioned calves with regards to percussion massages.  Even the websites had videos, but they never showed them doing the calves.  So in reading reviews, the Thumper came across as the best one for the money.  I said, what do i have to lose, this is the last time before i go to see the doctor or sports therapist.  I was just in to much pain just waking around the house.  So to make a long story come to a close.  I ordered the Thumper Sport.  I have had it about 1 month.  The first two days i used it, no results....but it felt good.  After about the 3rd or 4th try, i noticed that my calves were slowly getting more flexible.  After about a week and a half or two weeks of using this every day...the pain totally stopped and my calves were flexible again.....I still can't believe that after years of pain, all i needed as this product. It's amazing.  This product is awesome and I will always use one - forget the regular massager...waste of money.  I regularly use this every 2 days for about 10 minutes on my feet, calves, thighs, back and even the palms of my hands.After about a week and a half or two weeks of using this every day...the pain totally stopped and my calves were flexible again.....I still can't believe that after years of pain, all i needed as this product. product_title: MedMobile® BATHTUB TRANSFER BENCH / BATH CHAIR WITH BACK, WIDE SEAT, ADJUSTABLE SEAT HEIGHT, SURE-GRIPED LEGS, LIGHTWEIGHT, DURABLE, RUST-RESISTANT SHOWER BENCH
review_body:
My Situation: Broke my hip socket and was told not to put any weight on my right foot. When I left the hospital, they gave me an old man walker and a commode, which they told me could double up as a shower bench. Bad idea listening to the people ran by the insurance company. The commode is not made to withstand rust, fit well inside a bathtub, nor make it easy for someone to get in and out of a bathtub.

Solution: Get a real shower bench and this one was priced right. I've been using it for the past 3 weeks and now I look forward to taking a shower because of its convenience. I'm 215 lbs.

Wide Seat: Yes, the seat is wide and supports my big behind. It's plastic, so don't expect a soft cushy seat and it's cold because plastic is not a good insulator. I like the fact that it's long, so I can sit easily, then slide myself all the way into the bath tub and close the shower curtain. This prevent water from splashing outside the tub, which I consistently saw when using the commode as a shower seat.
Adjustable Seat Height: Adjustments can easily be made by pressing the button tabs on each leg and they feel sturdy. This is important because at the right height, it makes standing up with one leg a lot easier.
Sure Gripped Legs: Two legs in the rear have strong suction cups. This makes it difficult to move once the one in the bathtub takes hold. The two in the front have rubber grip to prevent sliding.
Lightweight: Yes, relative to the effect of the suctions.
Durable: The aluminum portion feels durable, but the plastic squeaks with the pressure of my body weight. I need to use my hands to lift my body up and slide it across the bench, which means I am applying palm pressure on the bench. My suggestion is when you are doing this, be sure to place your palm where there is an aluminum support beneath it. This will provide a stronger support for the plastic seat against your body weight. I am sure if I'd put my palm right in the center, it will probably crack the plastic. I've actually left an imprint of my behind on the plastic bench after a week of use, which tells me the plastic may have certain limit that I am particularly not interested in discovering.
Rust-Resistant Shower Bench: Believe it's all aluminum. I have not seen any rust.

Overall: At my weight, I would recommend this bench for temporary use (less than 12 months). It doesn't feel like it will last forever and at this price, it's cheap enough to replace. If you are lighter, then the stress on the plastic will be minimal and may last longer. It's definitely been a life saver for me now because I've regain some of my independence.

Even so, it only took a few weeks for the entire process, and this was over the Christmas Holiday season...frankly I was impressed. The kit also included a backup batch of impression material in case the first attempt does not produce a satisfactory impression.  I made a good impression the first time, however, and I promptly placed it in the prepaid envelope and shipped it back to the company.  Surprisingly, I received the final product in the mail within another 10 to 14 days.  I was doubtful that this product would fit as well as the one made by dentist, but it surpassed all expectations...it fit PERFECTLY.    If this soft model lasts as I expect it will, I will look no further.  I will continue to usethis company and spend much less than what my dentist would charge.  If this one does not last as I expect, I will probably try the hard model made by the same company.    I would urge you to order this product with confidence.  If your experience is anything like mine, you will be completely satisfied.  And if you consider that you will be saving in the neiborhood of $420, I think you will be willing wait a few weeks to receive this awesome product.     7/29/09:  It's been over six months now, and I am still impressed by this product.  My night guard still fits nicely, and it doesn't interfere at all with my sleep.  There is virtually no sign of wear on my model, and I simply clean it using a denture cleaner tablet in a cup of water once a week...no fuss, no muss.  Folks, I'd buy this product again. product_title: Norelco 8865XL Spectra Shaving System
review_headline: I trust Norelco, but has their quality gone down?
review_body:
QUALITY: I have been using my OLD Norelco razor for almost 12 years. Since I excercise the batteries \\"correctly\\" (full discharge->full charge) they have lasted up until now. I don't baby it, and I have only had to replace the cutting heads a few times. The old Norelco was built like a tank and has been reliable and DURABLE. I recently started looking for a replacement and figured that if the new razor lasts only half as long, even $$$ is money well spent.
Upon opening the box, i was disappointed in several minor ways:
1) Can Norelco PLEASE learn \\"green\\" packaging? There is far more blow-molded plastic than necessary. The razor is about 16X the volume of the package.
2) The AC adapter has \\"grown\\" compared to the old model. It now has a small wall-wart. The older models used to be a simple plug into the wall. This could be annoying if I lose the special adapter.
3) The travel bag is an obnoxiuos light gray with a hint of lavendar, and larger than necessary. Simply not the most masculine of travel bags.
4) The fairly symmetrical head has a slightly asymmetrical clear plastic cover with no good directionality indicator. This lack of a poke-a-yoke means I'm gonna throw it out soon and go without it. Oh, and it doesn't stay on all that tight, either.
5) After first use, I did a \\"practice\\" clean. This worked fine until I gave it a minor shake dry....the head fell off! Easy to put back on (it's a simple metal leaf-spring), but funny nonetheless. C'mon Norelco....this is a \\"MAN's\\" product.

HOWEVER->
1+ It definitely gives a much closer shave than my old NORELCO, and quickly!
2+ It holds a lot of charge
3+ (Like my old unit) it has the sensitivity adjustment
4+ Even on \\"Normal\\" sensitivity, it doesn't pinch
my neck like the older model did.
5+ The trimmer works really well.
6+ The AC adapter cord stretches to 6ft easily.
OVERALL RATING: 4 stars. Although it doesn't feel like the tank my old unit was, this isdefinitely a top notch razor. I would have given it 5 stars except for the clear plastic cover. I plan on getting a good 5 years of daily shaves out of this one. WELL WORTH THE MONEY and i'm glad I bought it.

Saying that the heaters seem to be working fine.    -Some small pieces that were suppose to be tacked onto the floors had come off during shipping, but I was able to put it back together.    -The magazine rack was completely crushed so they are shipping me a new one.    -The stereo will now sit flush into the case, it sticks out about 1/2 an inch.
